tasks.instruction: Read the text below. Fill in each gap (1.1-1.6) with one word to make the text correct.
tasks.text:
Every year, thousands of people take part in a race 1.1. _________ is often described as the toughest in Europe. It is not the distance that makes it hard, 1.2. _________ the weather: competitors set off in the dark and finish, if they finish 1.3. _________ all, well after midnight.

Entries are limited, and applicants are chosen 1.4. _________ the basis of previous results rather than in the order they apply. Organisers say this is done in 1.5. _________ to keep everyone safe. Even so, roughly one runner 1.6. _________ four drops out before the halfway point.
